hypothesis: Elevated FINRA daily short-sale volume ratio (ShortVolume/TotalVolume) for SPY predicts near-term downward pressure in SPY the FOLLOWING trading day.
null_hypothesis: SPY next-day close-to-close return has no measurable relationship to that day's FINRA short-volume ratio -- median-split high-ratio days vs low-ratio days show no distinguishable next-day-return difference beyond noise.

data_sources.short_volume: FINRA Regulation SHO daily short volume files, https://cdn.finra.org/equity/regsho/daily/CNMSshvol{YYYYMMDD}.txt, ticker SPY, field ShortVolume/TotalVolume. Cost: $0, no auth required.
data_sources.price: backtest/data/spy_5m_2025-01-01_2026-07-14.csv + backtest/data/spy_5m_2026-05-19_2026-07-22.csv (merged, deduped), aggregated to daily close (last 5m bar of RTH per date).

methodology.sample_window: Last N available trading days where BOTH a FINRA short-volume file AND a SPY daily close AND the FOLLOWING day's SPY daily close exist (bounded network fetch -- most recent ~65 trading days, 2026-04-xx through 2026-07-21; today 2026-07-22 excluded as it has no 'next day' yet).
methodology.ratio_construction: short_ratio_t = ShortVolume_t / TotalVolume_t for SPY on trading day t (t's OWN FINRA file, strictly same-day -- no look-ahead: t's ratio is known only after t's session closes, same timing constraint as the return being predicted, i.e. this is a next-day-forward test using info available at day t's close).
methodology.split: Median split of short_ratio_t across the sample into HIGH (>= median) and LOW (< median) halves.
methodology.test: Compare mean next_day_return in HIGH vs LOW halves. Hypothesis direction: HIGH short-ratio days should show MORE NEGATIVE next_day_return than LOW short-ratio days if the prospector's directional claim holds.
methodology.significance: Two-sided permutation test (label-shuffle, 5000 draws) on the difference of means. Report exact p-value, not just significance flag.
methodology.pass_bar: Per OP-11/OP-16 standing autoresearch bar -- for THIS pre-reg (a first-pass correlation screen, not a full OP-21 wired-signal validation), the bar is: permutation p < 0.05 on the SAME DIRECTION as the hypothesis (elevated short-ratio -> more negative next-day return). Failing this is a clean, honest KILL for a first-pass screen; a full OP-21 walk-forward/OOS/anchor validation would only be funded if this screen clears.
methodology.disclosure: n_high / n_low reported explicitly; if either side has n<15, flag as underpowered per CLAUDE.md OP-16 evidence_n advisory threshold; no cherry-picking sub-windows after seeing the result.
